description: Computes compact, factual ecliptic positions and motion for selected planets, dwarf planets, or supported minor bodies at an Earth coordinate and local civil time. The result is calculated by the configured ephemeris service; it is not a static lookup or an interpretation. Price: $0.01 USDC per call after 25 free calls per day.

_payment.description: x402 v2 payment: base64 PaymentPayload, as you would send in the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. Only needed after the free allowance is used.

timezoneId.description: IANA timezone at the observer, e.g. Pacific/Auckland.

name: celestial_state
title: Celestial body state
